inductive NeedDisposition (law : RawLaw Party Good Port Technology Instrument)
    (before : RawCurrent Party Good Technology Instrument)
    (word : RawEvent Party Good Port Technology Instrument) (members : List Party) : Type
  | paid (complete : AllNeedsPaid law before members word)
  | necessity (actor : Party) (original : actor ∈ members)
      (unpaid : ¬ BundlePaid law before word actor (law.necessities before actor) .necessity)
  | maintenance (actor : Party) (original : actor ∈ members)
      (unpaid : ¬ BundlePaid law before word actor (law.mandatoryMaintenance before actor) .maintenance)

def inspectNeeds (law : RawLaw Party Good Port Technology Instrument)
    (before : RawCurrent Party Good Technology Instrument) (word : RawEvent Party Good Port Technology Instrument) :
    (members : List Party) → NeedDisposition law before word members
  | [] => .paid (by simp [AllNeedsPaid])
  | actor :: rest =>
    if necessary : BundlePaid law before word actor (law.necessities before actor) .necessity then
      if maintained : BundlePaid law before word actor (law.mandatoryMaintenance before actor) .maintenance then
        match inspectNeeds law before word rest with
        | .paid later => .paid (by
            intro next member
            rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | old
            · exact same ▸ ⟨necessary,maintained⟩
            · exact later next old)
        | .necessity next member unpaid => .necessity next (List.mem_cons_of_mem actor member) unpaid
        | .maintenance next member unpaid => .maintenance next (List.mem_cons_of_mem actor member) unpaid
      else .maintenance actor List.mem_cons_self maintained
    else .necessity actor List.mem_cons_self necessary

payment word. Valid prefixes of admitted words remain actual events. -/

  | paid (complete : ∀ key ∈ keys, state.remaining key = 0)
  | unpaid (key : Party × Good) (member : key ∈ keys) (positive : 0 < state.remaining key)

partially paid cells; it does not choose an unobserved future success. -/

def inspectPayment (state : State claim) : (keys : List (Party × Good)) → PaymentStatus claim state keys
  | [] => .paid (by simp)
  | key :: rest =>
    if zero : state.remaining key = 0 then

      | .paid later => .paid (by
          intro next member
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | old
          · exact same ▸ zero
          · exact later next old)
      | .unpaid next member positive => .unpaid next (List.mem_cons_of_mem key member) positive

def execute : {depth : Nat} → (code : Code (old := old) R depth) → Execution code
  | _,.done value => .done value
  | _,.replay before requests next =>
      let first := Mandate.Replay.Program.execute (leaf (old := old) before requests)

  | _,_,.catalogue _ later => later.value

  | _,_,.done _ => [.finish]
  | _,_,.replay first later => first.work.map Event.replay++later.work
  | _,_,.catalogue first later => first.work.map Event.catalogue++later.work

theorem Execution.unique : {depth : Nat} → {code : Code (old := old) R depth} → (first second : Execution code) → first = second
  | _,_,.done _,.done _ => rfl
  | _,_,.replay first later,.replay second rest => by
      cases first.unique second
      cases Execution.unique later rest;rfl
  | _,_,.catalogue first later,.catalogue second rest => by
      cases first.unique second
      cases Execution.unique later rest;rfl

  | _,_,.replaying session => session.work.map Event.replay
  | _,_,.replayed first later => first.work.map Event.replay++later.work
  | _,_,.cataloguing session => session.work.map Event.catalogue
  | _,_,.catalogued first later => first.work.map Event.catalogue++later.work
  | _,_,.done _ => [.finish]

def scan (current : Fin pool.length) : (remaining : List (Fin pool.length)) →
    Code Key (.number (Query.Refiner.Generic.Evidence R pool current remaining))
  | [] => .pure ⟨current.val,⟨current.isLt,reflexive _,by intro other inside;cases inside⟩⟩
  | head::tail => .bind (test current head) fun answer => match answer with
    | .isTrue better => .bind (scan head tail) fun later =>
        .pure ⟨later.val,⟨later.property.bounded,transitive later.property.no_worse better.1,by
          intro other inside
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp inside with same | rest
          · subst other;exact fun backwards => backwards.2 later.property.no_worse
          · exact later.property.maximal other rest⟩⟩
    | .isFalse notBetter => .bind (scan current tail) fun later =>
        .pure ⟨later.val,⟨later.property.bounded,later.property.no_worse,by
          intro other inside
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp inside with same | rest
          · subst other;intro backwards
            exact notBetter ⟨transitive backwards.1 later.property.no_worse,
              fun reverse => backwards.2 (transitive later.property.no_worse reverse)⟩
          · exact later.property.maximal other rest⟩⟩

def Cursor.move : Cursor cursor pricing source count → Option (Event cursor pricing source count × Cursor cursor pricing source count)
  | .ready state => match actual : state.remaining with
    | [] => none
    | head::tail => match produced : Future.produce cursor.model cursor.depth source.indexed count head with
      | .inl reason =>
          let made : Entry cursor pricing source count := ⟨head,Row.rejected head reason produced⟩
          some (.emit made,.ready ⟨tail,state.cached++[made],by
            have known := state.coherent;rw [actual] at known
            simpa only [List.map_append,List.map_cons,List.map_nil,List.append_assoc,List.singleton_append] using known⟩)
      | .inr receipt => some (.begin head receipt produced,.recovering ⟨head,tail,state.cached,by
          have known := state.coherent;rw [actual] at known;exact known,
          receipt,produced,Future.Recovery.Micro.Session.initial pricing (Future.Recovery.begin receipt)⟩)
  | .recovering state => match done : state.session.completed with
    | some execution =>
        let made := execution.output state.receipt
        some (.beginReport state.word state.receipt execution made rfl,
          .reporting ⟨state.word,state.tail,state.cached,state.coherent,state.receipt,state.produced,
            execution,made,rfl,Future.Recovery.Assessment.Fields.initial made cursor.depth⟩)
    | none => match moved : state.session.move with
      | none => False.elim (by
          have complete := (Future.Recovery.Micro.Session.completed_iff_stopped state.session).mpr moved
          rw [done] at complete;cases complete)
      | some (event,next) => some (.advance state.word state.receipt state.session next event moved,
          .recovering ⟨state.word,state.tail,state.cached,state.coherent,state.receipt,state.produced,next⟩)
  | .reporting state => match done : state.fields.completed with
    | some collected => some (.beginFunding state.word state.receipt state.made collected,
        .financing ⟨state.word,state.tail,state.cached,state.coherent,state.receipt,state.produced,
          state.execution,state.made,state.generated,collected,Future.Recovery.Funding.Source.initial state.made.walk⟩)
    | none => match moved : state.fields.move with
      | none => False.elim (by
          have complete := (Window.Report.Manifest.Cursor.completed_iff_stopped state.fields).mpr moved
          rw [done] at complete;cases complete)
      | some (event,next) => some (.field state.word state.receipt state.made state.fields next event moved,
          .reporting ⟨state.word,state.tail,state.cached,state.coherent,state.receipt,state.produced,
            state.execution,state.made,state.generated,next⟩)
  | .financing state => match done : state.funding.completed with
    | some collected =>
        let made : Entry cursor pricing source count := ⟨state.word,Row.funded state.word state.receipt state.produced
          state.execution state.made state.generated state.fields collected⟩
        some (.emit made,.ready ⟨state.tail,state.cached++[made],by
          simpa only [List.map_append,List.map_cons,List.map_nil,List.append_assoc,List.singleton_append] using state.coherent⟩)
    | none => match moved : state.funding.move with
      | none => False.elim (by
          have complete := (Future.Recovery.Funding.Source.Cursor.completed_iff_stopped state.funding).mpr moved
          rw [done] at complete;cases complete)
      | some (event,next) => some (.funding state.word state.receipt state.made state.funding next event moved,
          .financing ⟨state.word,state.tail,state.cached,state.coherent,state.receipt,state.produced,
            state.execution,state.made,state.generated,state.fields,next⟩)

    (word : RawEvent Party Good Port Technology Instrument) → SourceAdmission cohort victims word
  | [] => .accepted (by simp)
  | request :: rest =>
    if source : materialOperation cohort victims request then
      match inspectSource cohort victims rest with
      | .accepted later => .accepted (by
          intro next member
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | old
          · exact same ▸ source

    else .rejected request List.mem_cons_self source

inductive NeedDisposition (law : RawLaw Party Good Port Technology Instrument)
    (before : RawCurrent Party Good Technology Instrument)
    (word : RawEvent Party Good Port Technology Instrument) (members : List Party) : Type
  | paid (complete : AllNeedsPaid law before members word)
  | necessity (actor : Party) (original : actor ∈ members)
      (unpaid : ¬ BundlePaid law before word actor (law.necessities before actor) .necessity)
  | maintenance (actor : Party) (original : actor ∈ members)
      (unpaid : ¬ BundlePaid law before word actor (law.mandatoryMaintenance before actor) .maintenance)

def inspectNeeds (law : RawLaw Party Good Port Technology Instrument)
    (before : RawCurrent Party Good Technology Instrument) (word : RawEvent Party Good Port Technology Instrument) :
    (members : List Party) → NeedDisposition law before word members
  | [] => .paid (by simp [AllNeedsPaid])
  | actor :: rest =>
    if necessary : BundlePaid law before word actor (law.necessities before actor) .necessity then
      if maintained : BundlePaid law before word actor (law.mandatoryMaintenance before actor) .maintenance then
        match inspectNeeds law before word rest with
        | .paid later => .paid (by
            intro next member
            rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | old
            · exact same ▸ ⟨necessary,maintained⟩
            · exact later next old)
        | .necessity next member unpaid => .necessity next (List.mem_cons_of_mem actor member) unpaid
        | .maintenance next member unpaid => .maintenance next (List.mem_cons_of_mem actor member) unpaid
      else .maintenance actor List.mem_cons_self maintained
    else .necessity actor List.mem_cons_self necessary

inductive PaymentStatus (state : State claim) (keys : List (Party × Good)) : Type
  | paid (complete : ∀ key ∈ keys, state.remaining key = 0)
  | unpaid (key : Party × Good) (member : key ∈ keys) (positive : 0 < state.remaining key)

partially paid cells; it does not choose an unobserved future success. -/

def inspectPayment (state : State claim) : (keys : List (Party × Good)) → PaymentStatus claim state keys
  | [] => .paid (by simp)
  | key :: rest =>
    if zero : state.remaining key = 0 then
      match inspectPayment state rest with
      | .paid later => .paid (by
          intro next member
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | old
          · exact same ▸ zero
          · exact later next old)
      | .unpaid next member positive => .unpaid next (List.mem_cons_of_mem key member) positive
    else .unpaid key List.mem_cons_self (lt_of_le_of_ne (state.nonnegative key) (Ne.symm zero))
